name: Non-syndromic Polydactyly, Syndactyly and/or Hyperphalangy

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical Diagnosis of Non-syndromic Digital Malformations

criteria.description: Presence of one or more extra digits on hands or feet without associated syndromic features
Fusion of two or more digits involving soft tissue or bone without other systemic abnormalities
Presence of additional phalanges in one or more digits confirmed by radiographic imaging
No clinical or genetic evidence of syndromic conditions associated with digital anomalies

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: At least one major criterion (polydactyly, syndactyly, or hyperphalangy) with absence of syndromic features
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical supported by radiographic imaging and exclusion of syndromic causes

pathognomonic.notes: Extra digit located on the ulnar side of the hand

pathognomonic.symptomName: Complete cutaneous syndactyly between adjacent fingers
pathognomonic.notes: Soft tissue fusion without bony involvement
Presence of an additional phalanx in the thumb confirmed by X-ray

common.notes: Extra digit located on the medial side of the foot

minor asymmetry in hands or feet

skin connecting digits without bone joining

X-ray evidence of bony syndactyly or hyperphalangy
genetic: Mutations in GLI3, ZRS enhancer region, or other limb development genes (variable)
other: Physical examination revealing isolated digital malformations without systemic involvement
